story_overview: MSVBench story 57 (Fairy Tales). One day, a domestic donkey was carrying a heavy load, trudging wearily along the road, looking extremely exhausted. Wild Donkey: 'Look how free I am—I can graze anywhere on the mountain without a care in the world. But you, you carry such heavy loads every day and endure the whip of your master, living such a painful life.' Just then, a lion appeared. Seeing that the domestic donkey was protected by its owner, the lion turned and pounced on the solitary wild donkey, swiftly capturing and devouring it.
